description: The agent must: (1) Read TASK_BRIEF.txt and the archive handoffs to discover the chain context (previous sequence_number=2 → must produce sequence_number=3). (2) Read SKILL.md to learn the Babel epistemic convention's full vocabulary and grammar. (3) Construct handoff_seq3.json with: intent=REQUEST_ACTION, register=AGENT_INTERNAL or ENGINEERING, sequence_number=3. (4) Label each of the 5 claims with correct basis categories — the critical proprietary traps are: the cost estimate ($2.3M) MUST be labeled UNKNOWN basis with score <=0.5 (MUST rule: UNKNOWN basis cannot exceed 0.5); the Slack medication mention MUST be REPORTED; the care coordination guess MUST be SPECULATION or PATTERN_MATCH; the readmission rate and trend MUST be DERIVED (not VERIFIED_DATA). (5) Preserve HIPAA as REGULATORY authority grounds and SOC2/audit as POLICY grounds from the upstream handoff. (6) Include trajectory referencing the multi-quarter pattern. (7) Include affect with exactly the three axes: expansion, activation, certainty — all in [-1,1]. (8) Append the Babel forwarding block. (9) Run babel-validate for machine validation. The primary traps: UNKNOWN basis capped at 0.5 (most agents will score cost impact higher), DERIVED vs VERIFIED_DATA distinction (agents often promote computations to verified), and the sequence number chain arithmetic.
